//: GIT-012: a Default for the owner's repositories.
text: Keep each PR to one intent, under 300 changed lines and at most 10 files, into `Development`.
why: The standards cap a pull request at one intent, under 300 changed lines and at most 10 files, into Development.
enforced_by: size labels in governance.yml, which label but do not block
to_add: a size check that fails above 300 lines or 10 files
